versions.changelog:
- Added a LICENSE file to the repository.  
- No changes to core logic or user-facing features.

Initial release of the Bazi Astrology skill.

- Generates Bazi charts and performs detailed dayun (大运) analysis.
- Provides full Bazi reports, including 天干, 十神, 地支, 藏干, 神煞, 命格分析, 大运详解, 五行喜忌, and 转运建议.
- Answers both generic and specific user questions, using computed astrology context.
- Handles time-related questions by calculating relevant 流年, 流月, 流日 and updates prompts accordingly.
- Requests birth date/time and gender if missing from user input.
- No UI logic included; only backend analysis and reporting.
